description: This file defines the SetupScriptService class which manages setup scripts for worktrees, including reading, creating default scripts, and opening them in VS Code.

classes.name: SetupScriptService
classes.description: A class that manages setup scripts in a project, allowing to check existence, read, create default scripts, and open scripts in an editor.

methods.name: getScriptPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the setup script.

methods.name: hasScript
methods.description: Checks if the setup script exists at the specified path.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Asynchronously reads and returns the content of the setup script if it exists.

methods.name: createDefaultScript
methods.description: Creates a default setup script with a template and makes it executable.

methods.name: openInEditor
methods.description: Opens the setup script in VS Code editor, creating it if necessary.
